record_title: Endpoint weighted extension for monomial finite-type curves
limitations: The theorem settles only the monomial model, not the general fixed finite-type endpoint; the argument uses a global linear graph coordinate and explicit power-law two-point geometry; constants are not optimized; no Lorentz/weak endpoint, stability, or extremizer result is claimed; the direct source is very recent so an unindexed contemporaneous overlap may exist; cross-model review has not been performed.
